offers_products.reason: Licenses stock photos, videos, editorial images and illustrations as digital content, sold via subscriptions and packs.

offers_services.reason: Custom Solutions and Rights & Clearance exist but are side offerings; licensed content library is the core.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are brands, agencies, media and businesses licensing imagery; individuals are minor buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Marketing teams, agencies, publishers and media companies license images via subscriptions and enterprise plans.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription plans and repeat licensing by media and corporate customers drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Image licensing tied to advertising and marketing budgets, which customers can cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical purchases are small, frequent image downloads, packs or subscriptions.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for licensed content library and platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customer base is broad: agencies, publishers, small businesses and corporates; not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Digital content library and online platform; no plants, fleets or networks needed to grow.

notes: Customer mix between large enterprises and small businesses is uncertain from the website text.
